meta.title: Heritage — Whizzzest
meta.description: Wanzai fireworks craftsmanship, Desheng Drum, Kaikou Nuo, Xiabu weaving, Zhipeng folk songs — discover the intangible cultural heritage of Wanzai, Jiangxi, with videos.

hero.title: Living Heritage
hero.subtitle: Explore a millennium of cultural heritage in Wanzai

itemsDesc: Five items of intangible cultural heritage at county, provincial and national level — click through for videos and in-depth introductions.

items.title: Wanzai fireworks
items.summary: Renowned worldwide for their crisp reports, high burst rate and fragrance — over 4,000 varieties sell to more than 40 countries and regions.

items.title: Desheng Drum
items.summary: A folk drum tradition from the Northern Song era — thunderous, stirring rhythms and ever-changing formations that show the boldness and unity of Wanzai's people.

items.title: Xiabu weaving
items.summary: A 1,600-year-old handcraft weaving ramie grass cloth — light, breathable, and exported across the seas.

items.title: Kaikou Nuo
items.summary: Also known as "Tiaoxiao", a 600-year-old folk ritual where every role sings — a complete tradition of song, dance, speech and combat.

items.title: Zhipeng folk songs
items.summary: Work songs created by papermakers over 500 years — beautiful melodies with a rich local flavor.

items.title: Heritage experiences
items.summary: Hands-on heritage workshops are being prepared — stay tuned.

cta.title: Experience the heritage
cta.desc: Come to Wanzai and experience these living traditions first-hand — a millennium of culture, carried forward and reinvented.
